free_tier.stated: 1 GB of attachments per doc on Free, 10 MB per individual attachment, with no cap on the number of personal docs or their objects

egress.terms: Free; attachments served from Coda's CDN with signed URLs

tooling: Coda REST API (docs/tables/rows) can create rows with attachment values by URL; API is size-gated at 125 MB doc size
chaining: Per-record unlimited: 1 GB x unlimited personal docs x unlimited free workspaces. Personal (unshared) docs on Free have 'no object or row limits', so the 1 GB/doc is the only ceiling - 1,000 docs = 1 TB in one free account.
limits_note: 1 GB per doc total attachments; 10 MB per single attachment; docs over 125 MB lose the API and break cross-doc sync; shared docs on Free limited to 50 objects and 1,000 rows (so the docs must stay unshared to stay unlimited); 35 time-based automations/month
